items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 91:1
items.html: The first phase is the aspect of his soul that emerged at the time of smallness, which is the aspect of Nefesh of Keter. The second phase is the first nine Sefirot of Keter, meaning the RNHY in Keter. And the third phase is the nine Sefirot included in it, which are the NRNHY in each one of the lower nine Sefirot from Hochma downward. (682, item 92)
